Aspartic acid is a nonessential amino acid . Amino acids are building blocks of proteins. "Nonessential" means that our bodies produce it, even if we do not get this amino acid from the food we eat. Information Aspartic acid helps every cell in the body work. It plays a role in: Hormone production and release Normal nervous system function Plant sources of aspartic acid include: Avocado Asparagus Molasses Animal sources of aspartic acid include: Wild game Oysters Sausage meat Alternative Names Asparaginic acid References Hall JE, Hall ME.
